name: FuzeAgent Chat Streaming & Fuse Seam Design System
description: Redesign of FuzeAgent UX/UI in accordance with FuzeFront Design System tokens, inherited components, live streaming chat, modal dialog layout stability, high-contrast blueprint catalogs, multi-tier Brain RAG & S3 ingestion, and contextual portal dark/light theme switching. Managed and planned via FuzeX SaaS product workflow.

frames.label: (a) Real-Time Chat Streaming — LA Time
frames.summary: Demonstrates streaming assistant chat bubble with fuse seam glow, thought accordion, and live timezone card for Los Angeles.
frames.acceptanceNotes: WebSocket connection over /api/ws/multi-agent streams token chunks, displaying timezone response with live PDT clock and globe indicator.

frames.label: (b) Contextual Dark & Light Theme
frames.summary: Demonstrates contextual synchronization between FuzeFront portal theme and FuzeAgent inner workspace canvas.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Canvas dynamically reacts to data-theme attribute on documentElement and localStorage mutation, switching tokens without page refresh.

frames.label: (c) Active Sandboxes & Session Teardown
frames.summary: Lists active Kubernetes sandbox pods and provides graceful termination action.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Deleting or terminating session sends HTTP DELETE /api/agents/sandbox/{id} and frees pod and PVC resources cleanly.

frames.label: (d) Standalone Chat Window — OpenWebUI / Claude Style
frames.summary: Demonstrates full-window standalone conversational UI with thread history sidebar, model picker, live token stream, and telemetry drawer.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Provides dedicated separate window experience for multi-agent chat, compatible with pop-out and full viewport displays.

frames.label: (e) Deploy New Agent Modal & Blueprint Selection
frames.summary: Rigid 2-column modal dialog with dark backdrop blur, blueprint search & category filters, and right-hand specification inspector.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Prevents flex/grid sliver collapse in federated portal shell via explicit .modal-overlay and .modal-dialog.panel CSS primitives.

frames.label: (f) Agent Blueprints & Templates Hub
frames.summary: High-contrast blueprint catalog with verified badges, rating metrics, spaced category filter pills, and 1-click launch.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Ensures luminous primary typography (--text-primary) on dark elevation cards and spaced pill buttons across all categories.

frames.label: (g) Multimodal S3 Resumable Uploader & Ingestion
frames.summary: Per-org 5GB S3 bucket quota tracker, resumable multipart upload controls, and live Kafka ingestion stage badges.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Supports pause/resume/cancel multipart uploads and tracks Whisper transcription, OCR, pgvector indexing, and Neo4j graph sync.

frames.label: (h) Multi-Agent Task Assignment & Orchestration
frames.summary: Interactive task dispatch modal and multi-agent execution queue with priority weighting, memory scope selection, and live step stream.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Dispatches structured tasks via POST /api/tasks with agent assignment, priority level (1-10), and real-time step telemetry.

frames.label: (i) Enlightening Multi-Tier Context Pipeline
frames.summary: Interactive 5-stage RAG stepper: Fetching (4 tiers) -> Augmenting (Neo4j 2-hop) -> Distilling (RRF) -> Ready -> Streaming.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Displays transparent provenance chips across Agent, Team, Cross-Functional, and Organization brains.

frames.label: (j) Agent Persona & Avatar Studio
frames.summary: Human persona naming studio, role specialization badges, 4-tier brain attachment matrix, and deterministic SVG avatar generator.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Persists persona configuration and custom SVG avatar seed to orchestrator brain store.
